en: Color postcard view of a large historic market square. On the left stands an ornate Renaissance-style town hall with a steep greenish copper roof and richly decorated façade with arcades at ground level. On the right is a large twin-towered Gothic cathedral with tall green spires and a prominent rose window above three arched entrances. The square in front is busy with 1950s–1960s era cars and many pedestrians under a clear blue sky. There is no visible printed caption on the front.
